jobs.title: Senior Investment Strategist
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Dimensional's Investment Solutions Group (ISG) acts as a source of specialized investment knowledge that delivers thought leadership, education, and analysis to our clients through face-to-face interactions and compelling, informative content. As a strategic partner to Dimensional's client and distribution teams, ISG plays a critical role in helping advisors, consultants, and investors understand the value of Dimensional's investment philosophy and solutions.

The Senior Investment Strategist will lead the continued development of sales enablement capabilities within ISG while serving as a senior investment strategist and strategic partner to the firm's client and distribution leadership. The role combines investment expertise, cross-functional leadership, content strategy, and direct engagement with client-facing teams.

The successful candidate will partner with ISG leadership to establish and align with sales priorities, align content and training initiatives with business objectives, and develop scalable programs that help distribution teams communicate Dimensional's investment philosophy and solutions with confidence and consistency across client channels.

Responsibilities
- Develop and execute a strategic sales priorities alignment framework that supports Dimensional's global distribution efforts.
- Partner with client and distribution leadership to identify emerging client needs, field challenges, and content gaps.
- Design and deliver investment-focused training programs for regional directors, client relationship groups, and other client-facing professionals.
- Collaborate with Product Specialists, Portfolio Consulting, and Product Management teams to ensure consistency of investment messaging across audiences and channels.
- Develop processes to evaluate content usage, training effectiveness, and overall impact of sales support efforts.
- Serve as a subject matter expert for internal teams on Dimensional's investment philosophy, products, and portfolio implementation approaches.
- Establish feedback mechanisms with client and distribution teams to inform content development, training priorities, and strategic initiatives.
- Partner with Marketing and other internal stakeholders to support investment narratives, product campaigns, and business initiatives.
- Design advisor and internal education programs that improve investment fluency and communication effectiveness.
- Identify opportunities to enhance content accessibility, scalability, and adoption across distribution channels.
- Support high-profile client engagements, conferences, and industry events requiring advanced investment expertise and strategic coordination.
- Lead cross-functional initiatives involving ISG, Global Client Group, Marketing, and other key business partners.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree required; MBA and/or CFA strongly preferred.
- Minimum 10 years of asset management experience, preferably including experience in sales, distribution, product marketing, product management, or investment strategy.
- Prior leadership or team management experience preferred.
- Experience developing investment content, training programs, or sales enablement initiatives.
- Deep understanding of Dimensional's investment approach and solutions, as well as advisor and investment consultant business models.
- Excellent analytical, verbal, written, and presentation skills.
- Demonstrated success supporting commercial organizations through investment expertise, education, and strategic initiatives.
- Strong leadership, communication, and coaching capabilities.
- Ability to influence stakeholders across functions and levels while operating effectively in a collaborative environment.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Investment Stewardship
jobs.description:
Job Description:
The Investment Stewardship Group
Dimensional’s global investment stewardship activities are managed by the Investment Stewardship Group, which sits within Dimensional’s Portfolio Management department. The Group implements proxy voting policies, engages with portfolio companies, researches governance issues and industry trends, and communicates Dimensional’s approach to investment stewardship to internal and external audiences. The team works closely with multiple stakeholders including portfolio managers, Legal, Compliance, Investment Engineering, Investment Solutions, Marketing, and the Global Client Group, to ensure best practice is maintained and our clients’ objectives are met.

The Opportunity
The Senior Associate, Investment Stewardship responsibilities include oversight of the corporate governance practices of Dimensional’s portfolio companies, which includes proxy voting at shareholder meetings and engaging with company boards, management, activist investors, or other stakeholders as necessary. The Senior Associate, Investment Stewardship, working with team members based in Dimensional’s US and Sydney offices, will be responsible for delivering reporting on Dimensional’s stewardship activities to internal and external stakeholders.
The Senior Associate, Investment Stewardship is based in our London office and reports to the Head of Investment Stewardship.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify meaningful portfolio company engagement opportunities, participate in engagements, and track outcomes.
- Assist with preparation of responses to internal and external requests relating to investment stewardship policies and procedures, including RFPs, and questions from consultants and clients.
- Vote proxies in an accurate and timely manner.
- Identify and research key corporate governance issues and trends within the industry.
- Monitor regulatory developments for potential impact on Dimensional.
- Prepare reports and materials for key internal stakeholders, such as the Investment Stewardship Committee.
- Identify opportunities for the improvement in the efficiency and reliability of the group’s procedures and operations, including through automation and systemization.

Requirements
- A bachelor’s degree or equivalent is required.
- Experience of mutual funds or investment industry experience.
- Experience in investment stewardship, portfolio company analysis, and proxy voting mechanics.
- Ability to manage high-profile engagements with senior executives and board members.
- Strong writing and analytical skills.
- Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality reports for internal and external distribution.
- Demonstrated ability to compile, manage, and interpret data as well as perform in-depth research and analysis.
- Experience working asynchronously with a global team strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Associate Portfolio Manager (MBA)
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Portfolio Management is responsible for the daily oversight and management of Dimensional’s funds and implements our investment philosophy across all our investment solutions. Portfolio Management interacts and collaborates closely with several departments including Trading, Research, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and the Global Client Group to ensure a superior investment experience for our clients.

The Portfolio Management team ensures that Dimensional’s ETFs deliver consistent and efficient exposure to the dimensions of higher expected returns, as identified by the greatest minds in modern financial economics. Our portfolio managers achieve this exposure by implementing a daily and systematic portfolio management process. In addition to overseeing and enhancing this process, portfolio managers also interact with current and prospective clients.

As an Associate Portfolio Manager, you will cover all aspects of managing ETFs and other types of equity portfolios, and will also be responsible for discussing our investment thesis and portfolios to a wide range of clients.

Duties and Responsibilities
- Responsible for all aspects of managing ETFs and other types of portfolios. This will include tasks such as issuing buy and sell instructions in global markets, making ETF Create and Redeem baskets, trading foreign currency, electing on corporate actions, and evaluating the eligibility of securities.
- Monitor ETF characteristics and maintain portfolio structure following the process-driven approach of the firm, identifying buy and sell candidates in a systematic manner and partnering with trading teams globally to implement those decisions.
- Partner with Capital Markets to enhance ETF market quality and efficiently manage flows.
- Provide verbal and written explanations of Dimensional funds, performance, process, and other investment related issues internally and to both existing and prospective clients.
- Challenge current thinking and search out new opportunities to continually evolve Dimensional’s investment offerings.
- Collaborate with the Sales, Marketing, Consultant and Client Services teams to effectively respond to clients’ investment needs.
- Project work focused on making the investment process as efficient as possible.

Desired Experience and Traits
- Currently enrolled in MBA program with an anticipated graduation between December 2026 – June 2027

- Strong philosophical alignment with Dimensional’s investment strategy
- 5+ years of experience in financial services
- Excellent quantitative problem-solving and analytic skills
- Intellectual curiosity
- Solid communication and presentation skills
- Comfort with large data sets
- High attention to detail
- Strong time-management skills
- Aptitude for learning basic computer programming languages
- Knowledge of SQL, VBA and Excel is helpful
- Bachelor’s degree required

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

jobs.title: Analyst/Associate, Research (Fixed Income)
jobs.description:
Job Description:
The Research Department at Dimensional is integral both in the successful day-to-day functioning of the firm and in developing Dimensional’s long-term strategy. The team produces high-quality, thought-leadership research on investments and financial markets that is of interest to clients. The team also leads the development of the firm’s investment approach, the application of that approach through portfolio management and trading, and the implementation of technology solutions that make the investment process more efficient.

Our team seeks an analyst or associate capable of supporting key initiatives spanning Research and other investment and client service teams across Dimensional. The work is team based and involves designing and building systems and processes to improve operational efficiencies, running empirical analysis on a broad scope of investment topics, and maintaining data sets and tools key to portfolio decision making. Success in the role will mean learning both the broad principles of Dimensional’s investment philosophy and the nuanced application of those principles in our investment process, as well as successfully maintaining the operational processes that drive Dimensional’s investments.

Responsibilities:
- Execute and analyze simulations for research on asset pricing models and economics studies.
- Compile and manage large data sets from multiple sources.
- Execute regular validations to ensure inputs to research, portfolio management, and client reporting are appropriate and accurate.
- Review academic papers to improve our understanding of asset pricing and academic landscape. Identify opportunities to further our research agenda and conduct analyses. Present findings to internal research teams.
- Coordinate with investment and client service teams to answer internal and client questions.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance/Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
- Demonstrated capacity for and interest in quantitative work.
- At least one year of professional work experience.
- Knowledge of databases and query language (T-SQL, SAS) is highly considered, as pulling data from databases and performing analysis are a major component of the job.
- Proficiency in Python programming is required. Other coding skills (R, Matlab, Fortran, or SAS) are a plus.
- Knowledge of econometrics, statistics, probability, financial markets, and investments.
- Knowledge of finance and economic theories, including deep understanding of portfolio theories and empirical asset pricing models such as the CAPM and the Fama-French factor models.
- Strong written and oral communication skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Intellectual curiosity combined with attention to detail.
- Detail-oriented and comfortable working with large datasets.
- Knowledge and experience in fixed income, derivative pricing and applying machine learning in asset pricing research is a plus.

This role is not eligible for immigration support.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Investment Operations
jobs.description:

$75,000 - $100,000 This role may also be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Job Description:
Dimensional’s Investment Operations team coordinates and provides oversight of Dimensional’s service provider relationships, including global transfer agents, fund accounting and administrative agents, custodians, and a complex network of service groups that provide fund operations services to the firm’s primary and regional offices. The Senior Associate will assist in the daily oversight of outsourced fund operations functions with regard to Dimensional’s mutual fund and ETF business as well as other external vendors.

Responsibilities:
- Oversee daily operations with service providers for Dimensional’s mutual fund and ETF business as well as other external vendors.
- Perform oversight of Fund service providers to ensure adherence to established accounting policies and procedures
- Responsible for NAV production oversight and reasonability review against relevant fund benchmarks.
- Review daily deliverables from fund service providers
- Evaluate exceptions in NAV production process and work with internal stakeholders and fund service providers to resolve Analyze root cause of exceptions and ensure remediation of root cause
- Support new fund products and launches
- Participate in system enhancements, testing, and process improvement
- Oversee vendor performance by monitoring KPIs; ensure service provider / Dimensional adheres to all contractual policies, procedures and controls through review of contractual Service Level Agreements
- Provide oversight of daily metrics and reporting deliverables received from service provider; track issues and trends as they occur across vendors, recommend and implement solutions together with service provider
- Service client inquiries and provide quality service and excellent customer experience to clients, registered investment advisors, banks, broker/dealers and other service providers; coordinate associated internal and external information flow
- Manage escalated issues from internal & external stakeholders; ensure timely development of operating controls
- Oversee cash reporting for funds and projections to portfolio managers
- May serve as lead in supervisor’s absence; responsible for reviewing others’ work in certain cases
- Provide support for other Dimensional product lines as needed which may include UCITS, Canadian Funds and SMAs

- Improve existing processes to help scale the business.

- Bachelor’s degree.

- A passion for the asset management industry and capital markets.

- Ability to contextualize detailed analysis (trees) in service of a strategic goal (forest).

- Excellent analytical, interpersonal, and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to articulate investment concepts.

- Ability to resolve problems effectively and exercise independent judgement.

- Motivated to self-teach skills and apply learned knowledge to relevant tasks.

- Eager to learn and responsive to constructive feedback and guidance.

jobs.title: Project Compliance & Risk Manager - 12 Month Contract
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Dimensional is a global investment manager and a leader in applying advanced financial science to equity and fixed income investment strategies. For more than 30 years, we have translated research into real-world investment solutions for clients.

This role is to support the Compliance & Risk function in delivering the annual Compliance Plan review, strengthening the control environment, implementing key regulatory and compliance projects and improving existing processes and operational efficiencies.

This is a 12 month Fixed Term Contract

Key Responsibilities

1. Compliance Plan & Control Improvements

- Assist with the delivery of the annual Compliance Plan review.
- Review and enhance existing compliance controls, procedures and monitoring activities.
- Identify control gaps and opportunities to strengthen the compliance framework.
- Support the implementation and tracking improvement initiatives.

2. Compliance Projects & Delivery

- Coordinate and deliver assigned compliance and regulatory projects within agreed timeframes.
- Support the implementation of regulatory changes, including updates to policies, procedures and controls.

3. Process & Operational Improvements

- Review existing compliance processes to identify opportunities for simplification and efficiency.
- Develop and implement practical improvements to compliance workflows, documentation and reporting.
- Improve consistency, effectiveness and efficiency of compliance activities.

4. Ongoing Compliance Support

- Assist with compliance monitoring, incident management, regulatory reporting and governance activities.
- Undertake ad hoc compliance activities and research.

Key Skills & Experience

- At least seven years experience in compliance or a related role at a Responsible Entity, Fund Manager or Investment Management business.
- Good working knowledge of the regulatory obligations of a Responsible Entity, most notably the relevant obligations contained within the Corporations Act and ASIC Regulatory Guides.
- Experience managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Proven experience balancing commercial considerations with reputational and legal risk.
- Exceptional communicator and a natural ability to effectively engage with senior management, directors, clients and other external stakeholders.
- Strong work ethic and ability to demonstrate initiative, personal integrity and act as a mentor to junior members of the team.
- Ambitious self-starter who is capable of rapidly learning key elements of the business, managing multiple projects and meeting deadlines.

Why DFA
- Hybrid working model for most roles, which permits working 2 days remotely each week. This maximizes in person collaboration and interaction while simultaneously providing flexibility!

- Further flexibility for those days in the office through our core hours policy of 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., allowing all employees the opportunity to balance work with their personal and family needs.

- Great career opportunities, both locally and potentially abroad.

- Subsidized health insurance for individuals and family with several ‘nil-cost’ options available for individuals.

- Access to our health and fitness incentive program.

- Up to 16 weeks of paid primary caregiver leave if you have worked with us for 12 months or more.

- We provide financial and other support for those on a fertility journey, seeking to adopt, expecting a child or with a newborn, or entering menopause.

- Reimbursement for pre-approved study, such as CFA, via our Global Education Assistance Policy as well as access to exam leave.

- Free access to mental health and wellbeing support for you and your family through our Employee Assistance Program.

- Access to life and salary continuance insurance.

- Inclusive and fun social events and activities including Culture Quarters, monthly Take 5 events, run clubs, netball teams and more!

- Training to staff and leadership on sexual harassment, discrimination and the importance of respectful, safe and inclusive workplaces.

jobs.title: Sales & Business Development - Regional Director
jobs.description:
For this position, which is subject to credentials, industry experience, education, training/certifications, and/or geographic differentials, Dimensional reasonably expects to pay a salary range of:

$150,000 - $175,000 This role is also bonus eligible.

Job Description:

Please note, for the right candidate with a great network we can hire Regional Directors on a remote basis in Northern California. We also have openings on a hybrid schedule from our offices in Santa Monica, Charlotte and Austin.

This role is a great way to express interest in Regional Director positions at Dimensional. You will discuss specific channels at the point you speak with a recruiter depending on role availability and experience.

As we continue to grow, Dimensional Fund Advisors is looking for accomplished sales professionals across all our US offices. Our external sales positions are known as Regional Directors, with responsibility for business development and relationship management of both new and existing clients in a designated distribution channel and territory. Whether you are supporting independent advisors, pension funds, or any other client types, you will be responsible for all sales-related activities as well as organizing the efforts of client service team members to effectively address the needs of your client base.

What do we look for in a Regional Director?

We look for individuals with a strong foundational knowledge of investments, capital markets, and asset allocation theory to be able to discuss the sophisticated investment solutions that Dimensional provides. Just as importantly, a Regional Director must have excellent business development skills and a truly client-centric approach. We look to our sales leaders to be company ambassadors that coach, guide, and secure new business while deepening existing relationships. Ultimately, the goal is to help our investment solutions reach as many people as possible. We reward based on sales performance as well as demonstrating strong team orientation and leadership behaviour.

Typical expectations of a Regional Director:
- Sales activities and management of clients within a territory.
- Develop new client relationships as well as retain and develop existing relationships.
- Present Dimensional’s investment capabilities, investment theory, and performance to individual clients, at company conferences, and industry functions.
- Participate and engage as a team player and offer sales and marketing collateral within the Dimensional team.
- Be a spokesperson and ambassador of the Dimensional brand and investment theory throughout the industry and marketplace.
- Increase revenues, AUM and new clients within the territory through the growth of Dimensional’s product suite.

What good looks like for a Regional Director:

Your success as a Regional Director at Dimensional is influenced by proactive relationship-building activities and the financial results that are derived from those activities.  Key focus areas:

- In-person territory management : You will travel extensively across your assigned territory and build relationships via a combination of face-to-face meetings and virtual communication.
- Sales Success Factors: You drive commercial growth through day-to-day sales activities that build long-term trust. By showing up at regional events, networking actively, and genuinely supporting your clients, you create a natural pipeline of new business that drives net new revenue.

Who should apply?

If you are motivated by putting clients’ needs first, are passionate about world class investment solutions, and you are driven by a results-oriented mindset, then we would love to hear from you. Ideally, you will align with Dimensional’s investment philosophy and be able to articulate its place in the market. You should possess a strong educational background and a passion for continued learning that goes hand in hand with intellectual curiosity. You will need to be a self-starter who can demonstrate a track record of building relationships and growing a territory. We value people with entrepreneurial spirit, a desire to continually grow and develop, possess intellectual curiosity, and are confident communicators that show true competitive spirit.

If you are not currently working within asset management, it would be great to see a cover letter/profile that tells us about your desire to change to the buy side..

Please note SIE (Securities Industry Essentials), Series 7, and Series 63/66 licenses required; SIE and Series 7 must be obtained within the first 12 weeks of hire as a condition of employment.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.
